name: Sterling Financial
source: Sterling Financial Holdings Company Plc condensed unaudited interim financial statements for the period ended 30 June 2026, GROUP June 2026 column, in millions of naira; EPS filed in kobo | CRON 20261117: 9M 2026 column from the Sterling Financial Holdings Company Plc directors report on the affairs of the company for the period ended 30 September 2026, NGX doclib, group column, printed in millions of naira and stored as absolute naira. Gross earnings 454,939 million; profit before taxation 97,282 million; taxation 21,910 million; profit after taxation 75,372 million. Ties exactly: 97,282 less 21,910 equals 75,372. This is the directors report summary; the condensed statement of profit or loss itself was not the page dumped from this filing, so only the four printed summary lines are stored and no expense split is asserted. | CRON 20261120: FY2023 Profit Before Tax and Net Profit replaced with the audited group figures, and FY2022 Profit Before Tax and Net Profit filled. Both audited annual reports print the same 2023 column: FY2023 AFS page 3 (report of the directors) and page 27 print profit before income tax 22,693 million, income tax 1,109 million, profit after income tax 21,584 million, basic EPS 75 kobo, and the 2022 comparative 20,757 / 1,459 / 19,298 with EPS 67 kobo. The file had carried 43,675 million profit for both FY2023 and FY2024; 43,675 is the FY2024 figure only. FY2024 EPS corrected from 31.0 to 1.51: the audited FY2024 AFS publishes 151 kobo basic and diluted (profit 43,675 million over 28.8 billion shares), 31.0 matches no printed figure. Sources: https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/41335_STERLING_FINANCIAL_HOLDINGS_COMPANY_PLC-_QUARTER_5_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2023_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_MAY_2024.pdf and https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/44296_STERLING_FINANCIAL_HOLDINGS_COMPANY_PLC-_QUARTER_5_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2024_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_JUNE_2025.pdf | CRON 20261120 (9M 2026 EPS): 11.35 naira, the printed basic and diluted figure on page 2 and page 14 of the Q3 2026 statement, on a profit after taxation of 75,372 million. The same filing states the figure is restated for a share reconstruction of one new ordinary share for every ten existing shares effective 8 October 2026 (IAS 33.64), so it is not comparable with the as-filed annual EPS in the earlier columns. https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/48209_STERLING_FINANCIAL_HOLDINGS_COMPANY_PLC-_QUARTER_3_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_OCTOBER_2026.pdf
